text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Admin time dropped, but not where we expected.** Reps saved the most time on CRM updates after calls, about 4 hours a week, not on the meetings themselves.

**2. Follow-ups got faster.** Summaries went out the same day instead of two days later. Prospects noticed.

**3. Consent matters.** Some buyers hesitated at first. Asking up front, with a one-line explanation, fixed it.

**4. Accuracy needs a human check.** Product names and numbers were occasionally wrong. Reps now skim before sending.

**5. Managers gained coaching material.** Call snippets beat memory in 1:1s.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It gave reps more time to use it.

What has your team learned from AI note-takers?
